name: video_extract_frames
description: Extract still frames from a completed video creation at given timestamps (free, no AI). Pass the timestamp "last" to grab the final frame — the image to send as keyframes.start when extending a video whose source has no stored last-frame (mediaCollection has no type:frame, index:-1 item). Returns one queued IMAGE creation per timestamp; the source video is untouched.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed video creation to extract frames from.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

timestampsSeconds.description: 1-10 timestamps, in seconds from the start of the video, or the string "last" for the final frame (e.g. to chain into an extend-from-last-frame generation). One still-frame creation is queued per value.

visible.description: Whether the frames appear in the user's library and feed. Defaults to true. Pass false for a working intermediate you will only feed into another tool (e.g. keyframes.start of video_generate); the returned identifiers stay usable as input either way.
